title: Berlin Transit: renewal and announcement latency

sentences.speaker: Karl Brandt
sentences.text: At peak hours a station announcement starts almost a second after we trigger it.

sentences.speaker: Priya Raman
sentences.text: Our measured time to first byte for your region is around seven hundred milliseconds.

sentences.speaker: Karl Brandt
sentences.text: That is too slow. Passengers are already walking away by the time the voice starts.

sentences.speaker: Lena Hoffmann
sentences.text: We would like to see that under three hundred, and a regional endpoint in Frankfurt.

sentences.speaker: Lena Hoffmann
sentences.text: Also data residency. Could this run on-prem or in a private cloud inside Germany?

sentences.speaker: Priya Raman
sentences.text: I will bring both to our platform team. I can't promise dates on this call.

summary: Berlin Transit renewed but wants streaming latency under 300 ms and a Germany-resident or private-cloud option. No contractual date.
action_items: Priya to share latency findings with platform team
Priya to check Frankfurt regional endpoint plan
